known.note: An exit .Transition() declared on a keyed Memo does not play when the Memo is removed, so the control is gone at once. Other user dims are attributed by their own rules.

An exit .Transition() declared on a keyed Memo does not play when the Memo is removed, so the control is gone at once. The same with a facade Translation drag, which since layer 4 no longer changes the outcome; Translation.* drag cases are §9 row 3's.
A .Set facade Scale write mixed with modifiers or features: the setter re-runs and clobbers the declared value or is migrated by the handoff, and throws once the visual is taken.
A facade Translation drag mixed with .Translation(): since spec 066 layer 4 the modifier enables translation on the visual, after which WinUI ignores the drag once the element has rendered.
